description.value: I recently went through a crypto trading prop challenge with the [Crypto Fund Trader prop firm](https://cryptofundtrader.com/), and I can share some insight. One key thing I appreciated was that the challenge uses demo capital but still makes you focus on real trading strategies like consistency, risk management, and discipline. They offer up to $300,000 in virtual capital and allow trading across multiple instruments including more than 700 crypto pairs, which made it flexible for different strategies. What I found helpful was the fact that there are no strict deadlines, so you can take your time completing the phases, which definitely improved my patience and control. The leverage up to 1:100 allowed me to fine-tune lot sizes and stop losses without feeling forced into aggressive trades. Another important aspect was the allowance of trading news, even in high-volatility events, which gave a real sense of market conditions. If you’re curious, you can learn more about the structure and benefits of these challenges as I found it really changed how I approach trading discipline and risk.
